label: PF Backlog 55
title: Pluggable API gateway/service mesh (review later) - parked
body: Owner: keep APIs DIRECT for v1 (dashboard API layer is the only public surface with auth + rate limiting + input validation). Recorded for later review: pluggable gateway - nginx/Traefik/Caddy (self-hosted), Vercel edge (public), optional Kong/AWS API Gateway (cloud) - with TLS, JWT validation, per-tenant rate limiting, OWASP input sanitization, WAF, request size/timeout limits.
